letterbox.orientation: theta in radians encoded sin(2theta),cos(2theta); unchanged by isotropic resize

output.name: topface_raw
output.class_loss: hard-label sigmoid focal BCE gamma2 alpha0.25; background all6zero
output.score: max sigmoid(class_presence_logits), exactly once; no additional objectness
output.bbox_decode: softmax each8-bin DFL then expectation0..7 times stride; ltrb around grid
output.center_decode: grid + raw offset * stride; physical CAD center, not conic center
output.ellipse_decode: conic center=grid+channels48:50*stride; exp(log semiaxes)*stride; orientation atan2(sin2,cos2)/2
output.nms: host after declared sigmoid of class logits; class-agnostic top-face box NMS
output.capacity: 0 EMPTY,1..3 OK,4..5 OVER_CAPACITY; boundary ambiguity with<4 -> UNCERTAIN

loss_masks.physical_center: center_valid AND center_visible; hidden truth retained
loss_masks.center_flags: both flags always supervised for positive priors, including hidden center=false

output.geometry_safety: reject nonfinite raw output; reject exp-overflow geometry; normalize angle vector; canonicalize major>=minor and theta in[-90,90)deg

gate.scope: registered synthetic Pilot gate, not real acceptance
